candidates.reason: A sensible left-to-right banner order (logo, badge, phone, headline, CTA) with a dominant headline. But the subline is squeezed into a 5-line column of tiny text ('Bright / citrus, a / little bitter...') that reads as an awkward afterthought. The rotated NEW FLAVOR badge crowds the phone's halo, and the logo sits tight to the left edge.

Nearly the same as candidate 1: strong headline and a clear CTA, with the same broken 5-line micro-subline. The rotated badge overlaps the phone's cream disc more heavily, so the left cluster looks more muddled than candidate 1's.

The headline is shrunk to a small serif, and the dark CTA pill now outweighs it, so the hierarchy is inverted. About 190px of dead orange sits on the left while the logo floats off-axis at the top. The badge collides with the phone's disc. The only gain is that the subline stays on one line.

The square original is just shrunk into the middle of the banner. Headline, subline, CTA and logo are microscopic and unreadable, and more than 80% of the canvas is empty orange. Nothing was rearranged for the format.
